question: Revered as the 'Father of Carnatic Music', ________ is one of the most eminent musicians.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Purandar Das.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__****Purandar das**

__
 
• **Purandara Das was revered as the father of Carnatic music.**
 
• He is widely known as **'Sangeet Pitamah' **in recognition of his significant contribution to Carnatic music.
 
• He was a **great devotee of Lord Krishna, Vaishnava poet, saint and social reformer.**
 
• His guru Vyasatirtha narrates the glory of Purandar Das in a song: Dasrender Purandar Darasarai.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__****Tyagaraja**

 
• **Tyagaraja was a Bhaktimargi poet and a great musician of Carnatic music.**
 
• He enriched the society and literature as well as art.
 
• He was rich in versatility.
 
• He composed hundreds of devotional songs in praise of Lord
 
• Rama and his **the best known Pancharatna works are often sung at religious events.**

**M. D. Ramanathan**

 
• **M. D. Ramanathan was a Carnatic music composer and singer who created a distinctive style of singing rich in Bhava and Laya.**
 
• He was **selected for the Sangeet Kalanidhi Award of the Madras Music Academy in 1983.**
 
• Ramanathan **composed over 300 songs in Carnatic music in Tamil, Telugu and Sanskrit.**
 
• He used the word Varadasa as his currency in relation to his teacher Tiger Varadachari.
